notes.title: DREAMLINED Ver 1.04 Minor Update
notes.content:
A few small bugs have been fixed in this update:

[list]
[*] Fixed the cursor to one single screen to avoid issues with dual-monitor setups
[*] Fixed an issue with the static effect getting stuck during a scene transition
[/list]

notes.title: DREAMLINED is OUT NOW!
notes.content:
It's finally time to start your first [b][i]DREAMLINE [/i][/b]Session!

An excellent group of playtesters helped improve and stabilize DREAMLINED before it's public release, but with any solo-developed project there is always a chance you could run into bugs throughout your experience.

If you run into any issues, please visit the discussion board and post a reply in the bug reporting thread, or you can email me directly at midivagrant |at| gmail |dot| com
